# chaojiying-client

## Classes

### Chaojiying

Client for interacting with the Chaojiying (超级鹰) CAPTCHA recognition API.

#### Constructors

##### Constructor

> **new Chaojiying**(`options?`): [`Chaojiying`](#chaojiying)

Creates an instance of the Chaojiying client.

###### Parameters

###### options?

[`ChaojiyingOptions`](#chaojiyingoptions) = `{}`

###### Returns

[`Chaojiying`](#chaojiying)

###### Example

```typescript
import { Chaojiying } from "chaojiying-client";

const client = new Chaojiying({
  username: "your_username",
  password: "your_password",
});
const score = await client.getScore();
console.log(`Remaining points: ${score.tifen}`);
```

#### Methods

##### getScore()

> **getScore**(): `Promise`\<[`ScoreResult`](#scoreresult)\>

Retrieves the remaining points / score balance for the user account.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<[`ScoreResult`](#scoreresult)\>

###### Example

```typescript
const score = await client.getScore();
console.log(`Available points: ${score.tifen}`);
```

##### recognize()

> **recognize**(`image`, `codeType`, `options?`): `Promise`\<[`RecognizeResult`](#recognizeresult)\>

Recognizes a CAPTCHA image and returns the parsed solution.

###### Parameters

###### image

`string` \| `Uint8Array`\<`ArrayBufferLike`\> \| `Buffer`\<`ArrayBufferLike`\>

Image binary (Buffer/Uint8Array) or Base64 string.

###### codeType

`string` \| `number`

CAPTCHA type ID (e.g. 1004 for 4-letter alphanumeric, 1902 for general).

###### options?

[`RecognizeOptions`](#recognizeoptions)

Additional parameters such as debug instructions.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<[`RecognizeResult`](#recognizeresult)\>

###### Example

```typescript
import * as fs from "node:fs";

const img = fs.readFileSync("captcha.jpg");
const result = await client.recognize(img, 1004);
console.log(`Recognized code: ${result.pic_str}`);
```

##### reportError()

> **reportError**(`picId`): `Promise`\<[`ReportErrorResult`](#reporterrorresult)\>

Reports an incorrectly solved CAPTCHA to request a point refund.
Must be called within 3 minutes of receiving the picture ID.

###### Parameters

###### picId

`string`

Picture ID returned by recognize (pic_id).

###### Returns

`Promise`\<[`ReportErrorResult`](#reporterrorresult)\>

###### Example

```typescript
await client.reportError(result.pic_id);
console.log("Reported mistake successfully");
```

##### stackTraceLimit

> `static` **stackTraceLimit**: `number`

The `Error.stackTraceLimit` property specifies the number of stack frames
collected by a stack trace (whether generated by `new Error().stack` or
`Error.captureStackTrace(obj)`).

The default value is `10` but may be set to any valid JavaScript number. Changes
will affect any stack trace captured _after_ the value has been changed.

If set to a non-number value, or set to a negative number, stack traces will
not capture any frames.

###### Inherited from

`Error.stackTraceLimit`

#### Methods

##### captureStackTrace()

> `static` **captureStackTrace**(`targetObject`, `constructorOpt?`): `void`

Creates a `.stack` property on `targetObject`, which when accessed returns
a string representing the location in the code at which
`Error.captureStackTrace()` was called.

```js
const myObject = {};
Error.captureStackTrace(myObject);
myObject.stack;  // Similar to `new Error().stack`
```

The first line of the trace will be prefixed with
`${myObject.name}: ${myObject.message}`.

The optional `constructorOpt` argument accepts a function. If given, all frames
above `constructorOpt`, including `constructorOpt`, will be omitted from the
generated stack trace.

The `constructorOpt` argument is useful for hiding implementation
details of error generation from the user. For instance:

```js
function a() {
  b();
}

function b() {
  c();
}

function c() {
  // Create an error without stack trace to avoid calculating the stack trace twice.
  const { stackTraceLimit } = Error;
  Error.stackTraceLimit = 0;
  const error = new Error();
  Error.stackTraceLimit = stackTraceLimit;

  // Capture the stack trace above function b
  Error.captureStackTrace(error, b); // Neither function c, nor b is included in the stack trace
  throw error;
}

a();
```

###### Parameters

###### targetObject

`object`

###### constructorOpt?

`Function`

###### Returns

`void`

###### Inherited from

`Error.captureStackTrace`

##### prepareStackTrace()

## Interfaces

### ChaojiyingOptions

Configuration options for the Chaojiying client.

#### Properties

##### baseURL?

> `optional` **baseURL?**: `string`

Base URL for the Chaojiying API. Defaults to https://upload.chaojiying.net.

##### password?

> `optional` **password?**: `string`

Chaojiying user password (defaults to process.env.CHAOJIYING_PASS).
Can be either plaintext or a 32-character lowercase hex MD5 hash.

##### timeoutMs?

> `optional` **timeoutMs?**: `number`

HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000 (60 seconds).

##### userAgent?

> `optional` **userAgent?**: `string`

Custom User-Agent header string.

##### username?

> `optional` **username?**: `string`

Chaojiying username (defaults to process.env.CHAOJIYING_USER).
